caption:
After a full day at the desk, Mr Turtle plays three hours of guitar at band practice. Head down, one shoulder hitched up, and his neck feels it.

Playing an instrument means hours of small, repeated movements in one position. Remedial massage can ease that tight, heavy feeling in the neck, shoulders and upper back, but the effect is usually short-term.

Pair it with micro-breaks every 20 to 30 minutes and some upper back strength work, like band rows. Numbness, tingling, hand weakness or losing fine control is worth a physio or GP assessment first.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio. 🎸
